subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both the Google thinking sanitizer gap and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios auth-stack crash, or should the auth-stack crash be split into its own issue before more automation runs?
rationale: The issue discussion and current source point to two plausible root-cause slices with the same user-visible error, while the open sanitizer PR covers only one slice and dependency/auth changes need explicit owner direction.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Issue
options.body: Track both slices here until live Vertex proof shows the released user problem is gone or both fixes land.

options.title: Split Auth-Stack Follow-Up
options.body: Let the sanitizer PR remain linked here and move the ADC/gaxios dependency crash to a narrower issue with its own proof gate.

options.title: Close After Sanitizer Only
options.body: Treat the sanitizer fix as sufficient once merged and require any remaining ADC/gaxios failures to be reported fresh.

recommendation.title: Keep One Canonical Issue
recommendation.body: Track both slices here until live Vertex proof shows the released user problem is gone or both fixes land.

likelyOwner.reason: The most central current boundary is the Google thinking helper and SDK/plugin wrapper path, where this person has high-confidence recent history.
